name: Offense and Defense of the Furthest Ends

releases.name: Offense and Defense of the Furthest Ends

description.text: The last expansion pack of the Pokémon Card Game series before Diamond & Pearl, released on 29 June 2006. On the island at the end of the world, δ Delta Species Pokémon fight a final battle, with strong attacks, new Poké-Powers and Poké-Bodies, and Trainers that change how battles go. Its Pokémon ex are all Delta Species, among them Rayquaza ex, Latias ex and Latios ex, and its Star cards are Mew and Charizard. The cards are numbered to 68. In English it became EX Dragon Frontiers in November 2006.
